notes.title: Discount & Mac Release!
notes.content: [h2]Mac support & discount[/h2][p]We're happy to announce that Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition [b]now supports Mac! [/b]To celebrate, the game is on discount for the first time. So if you've been holding off grabbing a copy, now's your chance :)[/p][p][/p][p]There's also a tiny tiny patch to [b]1.0.3[/b] with a minor fix relating to Steam Stats.[/p][p][/p][h2]Other news[/h2][p]While we're currently working on our next project, we do have a content update in the works for Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition.[/p][p][/p][h2]Latest game jam[/h2][p]If you don't follow us on any social media (and we recommend you do), most of the team participated in our annual game jam a bit over a month ago. Check it out on Itch: [url="https://ottersea-studio.itch.io/depth-charge"]https://ottersea-studio.itch.io/depth-charge[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Cheers! Reid, Josh, Ciaran, & Kevin [img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3448930/extras/Hand_Want-Open.png?t=1746542726"][/img][/p]

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Leaderboard and bug fixes
notes.content: [p][b]Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Friends and global leaderboards for Endless Mode ([i]which unlocks after completing the main game[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Changed[/b][/p][list][*][p]Slap-hand speed is now frame rate independent.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Fixed[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed being unable to pick up items.[/p][/*][*][p]Items should no longer get stuck in the player’s hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Endless mode achievements are now unlocked correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of resolution issues, particularly for ultrawide monitors.[/p][/*][*][p]Player’s hand no longer suddenly appears at the start of a level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed both thumbs up and down being shown at the same time on the end screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the title of the ‘Bath Bed & Beyond’ achievement in-game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Cheers for the bug reports![/p]

notes.title: v1.0.1 - Thank you and first quick hotfix
notes.content: [p][b]Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Achievement data failsafe in place to update Steam achievements when game is opened.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you again for all the support, we're working hard on more bug fixes.[/p]

notes.title: It's Out!
notes.content:
[p][b]Aaaaaand... it's out![/b][/p][p]After a little over a year of working on this little game in our spare time, we're super proud to finally release [b]Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition[/b]![/p][previewyoutube="A6sb-JF19MA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Our team of 4 made a game jam in 2021 that was legitimately an untitled 'hand game'. For whatever reason, back in 2024 we thought we simply could squash the bugs, increase the amount of levels (from 1), and call it a day, all within a month. Fast forward to today and the game's code is entirely* rewritten. It has a fresh coat of paint, a complete soundtrack, and 8 times the number of levels.[/p][p][i]*Except for the bit that makes things move up-and-down (Kevin's handy work).[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Huge thank you to PostHorn PR, friends, and family for putting up with us <3[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers!
Reid, Josh, Ciaran, & Kevin [img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3448930/extras/Hand_Want-Open.png?t=1746542726"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The End is Untitled
notes.content:
[p]Hi again 👋 Before getting into what's next and a recap of what's been happening the past few weeks, we'd like to share a couple of lovely reviews we've encountered so far:[/p][p][/p][p][b]"It’s hectic, it’s fun, and it’s just plain silly. \[…] On the surface, [/b][b][i]Untitled Hand Game[/i][/b][b] seems like a goofy premise. Honestly? It is, and that’s why I’m fully on board with it at this point."[/b]
[i]- [url="https://www.vice.com/en/article/i-went-hands-on-with-untitled-hand-game-titled-edition-and-became-a-claw-machine-in-the-most-literal-sense-demo-impression/"]Vice[/url]

[/i][b]"Every time I thought Untitled Hand Game couldn’t get more absurd, it just continued to prove me wrong."
[/b][i]-[/i] [url="https://www.qualbert.com/queensland-games-festival-2025/#:~:text=Untitled%20Hand%20Game%3A%20Titled%20Edition%20%7C%20OtterSea%20Studio"]Qualbert.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We've also loved coming across a few streamers and YouTubers play the demo, and honestly, it's been super fun to see and we're keen for sharing the full game soon![/p][p][/p][h2]Releasing 1st of July[/h2][p]The team is working hard on squashing bugs and putting the final touches on the game, and we're on track to release in a couple weeks (and we're super excited).[/p][p][b]The demo also gets a patch:[/b][/p][h3]New[/h3][list][*][p]Added a hold behaviour option in settings. [i]Hold-to-hold[/i] is the new default, though you can toggle this off to get the old behaviour of [i]click-to-toggle-hold[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad gets a close prompt for overlay menus.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changed[/h3][list][*][p]Further tweaks to collision boxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated credits with some more wonderful folks who've helped us.[/p][/*][*][p]Logic adjustments to the way the god hand (hand that gives back items) works.[/p][/*][*][p]More emphasis given to the life counter when losing a life.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list][*][p]The god hand no longer breaks its "loop prison".[/p][/*][*][p]Player hand now doesn't clip through the floor on the end screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Hopefully patched randomly not being able to grab any items (this one is tough to test).[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, thank you for the bug reports and suggestions![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622770/Untitled_Hand_Game_Demo_Edition/" style="button"]Check out the demo[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Recap: Queensland Games Festival[/h2][p]Being our first free and public event, it was truly motivating to see people of all ages enjoy the game. Not only did we get lots of amazing feedback, it was great to meet and catch up with other local devs.[/p][p]Thank you to the Queensland Games Festival for organising a wonderful event and having us showcase alongside other amazing local games. We might see you there next year ✌️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447677/b88799792a407a0ffabcba06dea4a2bc68225688.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447677/a9b530826752aa558fef40e8cf398a0fcd206dc3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Cheers!
Reid, Josh, Ciaran, & Kevin [img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3448930/extras/Hand_Want-Open.png?t=1746542726"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Untitled Showcasing
notes.content:
[p]Hey hey! We're back with a cool little update about some events we have been, and will be, showcasing at with [b]Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447677/554fe3ac8dd9e2e26bcb058a97f2c476fffebe67.png"][/img][/p][h2]Steam Next Fest[/h2][p][i]9-16 June - (Online) Steam[/i][/p][p]Assuming we didn't mess anything up on Steam's back-end, we'll be participating in the next Steam Next Fest with Untitled Hand Game: Demo Edition. [b]We're also updating the demo![/b][/p][h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Added a fallback if items get stuck inside the box.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the player hand's movement and collisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked collision boxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for continuing to let us know about any bugs and improvement points![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622770/Untitled_Hand_Game_Demo_Edition/" style="button"]Check out the demo[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447677/afee404bda1ba8111c20200836bc9d1ba8d6bfee.png"][/img][/p][h2]Queensland Games Festival[/h2][p][i]14 June - Brisbane Powerhouse[/i][/p][p]If we hadn't mentioned already, most of the team is based in Queensland, Australia, and we're super proud to announce we'll be showcasing our game at the [url="https://www.queenslandgamesfestival.com/"]Queensland Games Festival[/url] in the Brisbane Powerhouse![/p][p]It's a free event, so come along on the 14th of June, say hi to the team, play the game early, and grab some goodies.[/p][p][url="https://www.queenslandgamesfestival.com/" style="button"]See event info[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447677/b3f6161de8f1d5d17d16c47fa5462fdc74111db8.png"][/img][/p][h2]INDIGO (Past)[/h2][p][i]27-28 May - WTC Rotterdam, The Netherlands[/i][/p][p]This post comes after the Benelux games industry event, [url="https://indigoshowcase.nl/"]INDIGO[/url], but we wanted to share the (old) news anyway![/p][p]It was the first time our small team exhibited a game at any physical event, and thankfully it as well it possibly could. We really appreciated industry folks came by, played the game, and gave some us great feedback and ideas.[/p][p]Huge shout out to our friend, Jan-Pieter, for helping set up and show-off the game. And thank you to INDIGO and their lovely volunteers for having us and organising such a smooth event.[/p][p]See you there next year, maybe??[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447677/6ea03f8a548e48e73951987d104c1a0a706cd205.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447677/478c59ca5d5f84209fc876b4876832878972dc0d.jpg"][/img][i]Photo by INDIGO[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Cheers!
Reid, Josh, Ciaran, & Kevin [img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3448930/extras/Hand_Want-Open.png?t=1746542726"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Hello & Demo Patch
notes.content:
Hello! Firstly, thank you so much for playing the little demo of our upcoming short game, [b]Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition[/b]. If you haven't tried it out yet, the demo features an endless mode of the game's first level, and now's a perfect time because we just fixed some bugs:

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some buttons on menu overlays not working.
[*] Fixed not translating to Portuguese via language selection.
[*] Various small bug fixes ("[i]Not 100% sure what I did but it probably made the game better[/i]").
[/list]
Please let us know if you happen upon any bugs or have suggestions on what to improve!

[h2]A bit about us[/h2]
To introduce ourselves, we're a small team based in Australia and Belgium, and this is our first game we're releasing to Steam. We've participated in game jams together for some years now, combining our domains of programming (Josh), art (Reid), game design (Kevin), and music (Ciaran).
We hope you'll enjoy our little game which releases soon!

Cheers,
Reid, Josh, Ciaran, & Kevin
